meta.title: Appi Kogen Ski Resort
meta.description: Morioka in 60 minutes — Tohoku's grand 21-course, 45 km resort with aspirin snow and integrated luxury hotels.

transit.title:
From Morioka,
into the alpine.
transit.lead: ~60 minutes from JR Morioka by car, bus, or train — a shinkansen gateway route to a world-class premium resort where ANA Crowne Plaza meets the slopes.
transit.imgAlt: Winter road from Morioka toward Appi Kogen — Iwate mountain scenery

primary.title: Tohoku-scale terrain
primary.lead: 21 courses and ~45 km of skiing across West, Central, East, and Appi zones — one of Tohoku's largest resorts. Central Quad and Sailer Gondola lift you to long cruises in dry aspirin snow.
primary.imgAlt: Skier on vast powder slopes at Appi Kogen — Tohoku's grand resort scale

secondary.title: After skiing, resort dining & baths
secondary.lead: From Japanese, Chinese, and yakiniku inside ANA Crowne Plaza to Shirakaba-no-Yu hot spring — stay, eat, and soak without leaving the resort footprint.

onsen.title:
Appi onsen &
Hachimantai baths
onsen.lead: Appi Onsen Shirakaba-no-Yu offers large saunas and open-air baths minutes from the resort. Azumino-yu and Sai-to onsen add post-ski recovery across the Hachimantai area.
onsen.whisper: Evening shuttle loops to local restaurants are under study — check the official site for the latest.
onsen.imgAlt: Snow-view rotenburo among birch trees — Appi Kogen onsen image

shirakaba.title: Appi Onsen Shirakaba-no-Yu
shirakaba.lead: 605-365 Appi Kogen, Hachimantai. Large sauna and rotenburo. Day use ~¥1,200 adults (official — verify). TEL 0195-73-6060.
shirakaba.imgAlt: Open-air bath at Shirakaba-no-Yu — Appi resort hot spring

azumino.title: Wataboshi Onsen Azumino-yu
azumino.lead: 436-1 Hosono, Hachimantai. Sodium bicarbonate chloride spring. Day use ~¥600 adults (official — verify). TEL 0195-72-6811.
azumino.imgAlt: Indoor bath at Wataboshi Onsen — local Hachimantai spring

saito.title: Shikikan Sai-to (Danburi-no-Yu)
saito.lead: 254-9 Akasakata, Hachimantai. Forest open-air bath. Day use ~¥720 adults (official — verify). TEL 0195-72-5344.
saito.imgAlt: Forest outdoor bath at Sai-to — Hachimantai snow-view soak

nearbyOnsen.pairingLead: Morning: Morioka → afternoon: long cruises at Appi → evening: Shirakaba-no-Yu → resort dinner → next day: beech forest trek.

gappei.title: Yakiniku Gappei
gappei.lead: 661-3 Appi Kogen, Hachimantai. Local favorite yakiniku for après-ski reward dinners. TEL 0173-29-4313 (official — verify).
gappei.imgAlt: Yakiniku at Gappei — local Appi Kogen grill

house-appi.title: HOUSE APPI
house-appi.lead: ANA Crowne Plaza Appi Kogen Tower 1F. Bakery restaurant — breakfast through light meals integrated with hotel stay. TEL 0195-73-5011 (official — verify).
house-appi.imgAlt: HOUSE APPI bakery restaurant — in-resort dining

powder.title: Aspirin snow at scale
powder.body: Dry inland Tohoku snow across 21 courses and ~45 km — West, Central, East, and Appi zones for weather-flex routing. Gondolas may close in high wind (check official ops).

morioka.title: 60 minutes from Morioka
morioka.body: ~60 min from JR Morioka by car, bus, or train — realistic weekend skiing via shinkansen. Rental cars unlock Morioka dining and wider Hachimantai loops.

resort.title: Resort stay model
resort.body: ANA Crowne Plaza Appi Kogen links directly to the slopes — near ski-in/out convenience. VIP products like BLACK PASS (30/day limit — verify on official site) target international premium guests.
